root_cause: Inherited BRAIN test assumes two self-workflow path filters for push and pull_request. Current canonical paginacontrole intentionally removed standalone pull_request fanout, leaving one main-push path, manual dispatch, weekly schedule, and one serialized repository writer. The original two-hit assertion contradicts established no-duplicate-fanout contracts.

observed.original_assertion: paginacontrole validates changes to its own workflow source

fix: Retain the current workflow unchanged. Replace stale two-trigger oracle with executable checks of exactly one self-path in main-push, absence of standalone pull_request, preserved manual dispatch and schedule, serialized non-cancellable repository writer; inject negative mutation canaries for removed self-path, added PR fanout and cancelled writer lock.
prevention_rule: Before changing CI workflow assertions, inspect actual workflow source plus parallel fanout/governance tests. Assert the canonical event model, not retired trigger counts. Never restore duplicate PR workflows or weaken writer serialization merely to satisfy stale source tests; preserve independent focused negative canaries and exact-head Required, CodeQL and full-run proof.
